prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong place to start for individual or family coverage: it describes itself as an independent Kansas City brokerage, says it compares Marketplace and private plans, and reports a 5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews. [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/)

If you’re choosing **Medicare** coverage, **Medicare KC** specializes in comparing Medicare Advantage, Supplement, and Part D plans. [Medicare KC](https://medicarekc.net/)

Before enrolling, ask any broker:
- Which insurers and plans do you represent—and which can’t you offer?
- Can you check that my doctors, hospitals, and prescriptions are covered?
- Am I eligible for Marketplace subsidies, and will you compare those plans?
- How are you compensated, and will you help if I have problems after enrollment?

Broker help is often at no direct cost, but brokers may not represent every plan. You can also compare Marketplace options directly at [HealthCare.gov](https://www.healthcare.gov/).
